content:
Meta's lead in the U.S. and Canadian App Store continues, with their AI assistant Muse surpassing 5 million downloads, according to data from Sensor Tower.

Muse has held the top spot on the U.S. App Store for 12 consecutive days

Three weeks ago, Meta launched Muse in the U.S. Shortly after launch, it quickly overtook ChatGPT to become the top free app on the U.S. App Store.

Sensor Tower senior insights analyst Kara Lee projects that Muse's downloads have surpassed 5 million as of today. This pace is far faster than ChatGPT, Grok, and Claude, which the market intelligence firm says took 56 days, 103 days, and 492 days, respectively, to reach the same milestone.

Muse is Meta's agentic AI assistant that can help users browse the web and perform tasks including sending emails, shopping, filling out forms, and booking travel.

Sensor Tower added that Claude and Grok were iOS-only for their first 5 days. In contrast, Meta's Muse app launched simultaneously on iOS and Android, though it is currently limited to users in the U.S. and Canada.

Top comment from Garth & Patricia L

It's incredible how many people trust Meta. I certainly don't.

The report added that while Meta's Muse app appears to have generated significant public interest, Meta's own advertising push is likely one of the reasons it has gained traction so quickly.

Sensor Tower noted: "Meta began ramping up advertising for Muse on Wednesday, September 16, 2026, resulting in a 73% day-over-day surge in downloads on that day." It added:

Sensor Tower also said that during the week of September 21 to September 27, Muse ranked among the top 15 brands in the U.S. for ad exposure.
